problem: Core router not forwarding MPLS traffic to downstream edge sites
symptoms: Packet drops between POP locations, rising latency, unreachable customer prefixes
root_cause: Routing table misconfiguration after a manual static route update on the core router
resolution:
show ip route
compare intended prefixes
configure corrected static route
clear stale forwarding entry
verification: Traffic restored, packet loss cleared, and downstream sites report normal latency

problem: BGP session flap between aggregation router and upstream carrier
symptoms: Intermittent route withdrawal alerts, short service interruptions, increased CPU on routing process
root_cause: Mismatched keepalive and hold timer settings after a peer template change
resolution:
show bgp summary
review neighbor timer values
apply matching keepalive and hold timers
reset the affected session
verification: BGP peer remains established for 30 minutes and external route advertisements stabilize

problem: Linux log collector node reports disk space full
symptoms: Write failures, delayed syslog ingestion, application crash loop on collector service
root_cause: Compressed and rotated log archives accumulated under /var/log and exhausted the root volume
resolution:
df -h
du -sh /var/log/*
archive or remove stale log bundles
restart the log collector service
verification: Disk usage returns below 70 percent and log ingestion resumes without errors
